novelty.justification: The claim’s novelty route is a new mechanistic measurement layered onto a known phenomenon: it proposes that an “Order-Mismatch score” between narrative order and a “logical-dependency DAG” predicts failure, while “attention recency bias mediates the effect” and explicit dependency reconstruction repairs it. Searches using “LLM premise order logical dependency order,” “reasoning premise ordering dependency DAG,” “narrative order recency attention LLM reasoning,” and “reconstruct premises logical order prompting” identify the closest work as Chen et al., “Premise Order Matters in Reasoning with Large Language Models” (ICML 2024), which already finds that accuracy is highest when premise order aligns with the ground-truth proof and drops substantially under permutation. Moving from that result to a graded per-instance DAG-distance measure, dependency-reconstruction hypothesis, and recency-versus-DAG-parent account is a substantive multi-step operationalization and mechanistic extension, but it is a natural extension rather than a wholly new core phenomenon because the central dependency-alignment prediction is already established.
